name: smwpatches-numerical
title: Numerical 3-Digit Dragon Coin Counter
description:
This patch replaces the normal Dragon Coin counter with a 3-digit numerical one. The new counter keeps track of the *total* number of coins you have collected rather than the ones within a single level, and each coin also saves to SRAM so that it cannot be collected again. Thanks to Alcaro for finding the (laughably small) thing that caused the bug in the previous version.

NEW - Added SA-1 support, converted it to asar and it allows to be used with SRAM/BW-RAM Plus.
